url.description: An http or https URL with a host and no credentials: a password in a URL is a secret in the file, and a secret is named, never carried.

description: The configuration of github-roster: the controller that makes each GitHub organisation's teams match the policy's github table. Secrets are never in this file: a field ending in ...Env holds the NAME of the environment variable that holds the secret, and a field ending in ...File holds a path. Telemetry is the OTEL_* environment, not configuration.

appsDir.description: One file per connected organisation: its App's credentials.

audit.description: The audit installation the controller records to, as its own workload. Unset only logs what it did.

catalogueFile.description: The GitHub App catalogue, read only so the warning about an internal group nothing consumes does not name a group a grant consumes. A missing or malformed one is never fatal here.

consoleURL.description: The console's API, which answers who holds a group.

enabledOrgs.description: The organisations the controller changes. Every other bound organisation is derived and reported, and left alone. Each must be one the policy binds.

policyDir.description: The directory the policy is mounted at: the bindings are the policy's github table.

release.description: The name the installation's objects carry. It must be the release's full name: the controller reads the report and the records the service writes under it.

tokenFile.description: This pod's projected ServiceAccount token, presented to the console and read afresh on every call.

title: github-roster
